This is followed by shots of a large nighttime event on the White House lawn, with a massive crowd and a stage. Other scenes include a large crowd at the Washington Monument under a rainbow, Trump walking through a crowd of photographers, a close-up of a smiling UFC fighter wearing championship belts, fireworks over the Washington Monument, and military jets flying in formation. Some shots use a picture-in-picture effect, layering different clips from the event.
